vulnerability.name: USN-7048-2
vulnerability.description: USN-7048-1 fixed a vulnerability in Vim. This update provides the  corresponding update for Ubuntu 14.04 LTS.  Original advisory details:   Suyue Guo discovered that Vim incorrectly handled memory when flushing the  typeahead buffer, leading to heap-buffer-overflow. An attacker could   possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service.

statements.status_notes: Vim could be made to crash if it received specially crafted input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
